The '''Battle of Foless''' was a battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. The Sith Empire launched a campaign from its holdings near [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]] and [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]] on [[Foless/Legends|Foless]], but the Republic emerged as the victors.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Foless makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.<ref name="EA" />
